title: Named herdr sessions
footer: Choose named herdr sessions (herdr --session <name>) on the selected computer to keep out of Persona. Blocking a session stops Persona from listing its tabs, workspaces, hooks, approval cards, live processes and remembered transcripts, while herdr keeps running. Unblock a session to show it again. The default server and persona-* data-directory sessions are managed automatically.
empty: No named herdr sessions detected or blocked on this computer.
offline_note: Offline or older node: showing saved blocked sessions only.
failed: Could not load or save herdr sessions: {error}
name_reserved: The default server and persona-* sessions cannot be configured here
